description: Validates that code does not use shell exec() with user-controlled input

rules.title: No shell exec with user input
rules.description: Functions that execute shell commands must not interpolate user-controlled parameters into the command string. Use execFile() or spawn() with argument arrays instead.
rules.validationQuery: No calls to child_process.exec() with interpolated variables

rules.title: Parameter allowlists for scaffold tools
rules.description: Tool parameters that map to shell commands (frontend framework, ORM, etc.) must be validated against an explicit allowlist before execution.
rules.validationQuery: Allowlist validation present for all tool parameters
